construction.value: Fuse the lower textured faceplate and middle ring into one manufactured lower body; retain the upper textured faceplate as a separate lid.

cord_attachment.value: Lanyard slot on the upper side following uploaded reference; the horizontal cut divides the existing ear between upper faceplate and core.

perimeter_detail.value: leather-style perimeter imitation stitching on both outward faces

manufacturing_method.value: FDM TPU 95A, leather-brown finish; decorative stitches may be painted ivory

closure.value: One plain horizontal upper lid interface; no snap fits, tongues, grooves, dowels or other locating features.

conservation_scope.value: daily physical protection; no waterproof or archival conservation rating

mating_edge_finish.value: Square flat upper lid joint; no fillet or chamfer on the mating perimeter.

assembly_method.value: Thin flexible TPU-compatible adhesive on the single upper flat interface; lower floor and sidewall manufactured as one solid.

slot_side_alignment.value: Marked lanyard slot sides align in X with the inner neck decoration lines immediately below the slot.

side_band_thickening_direction.value: Axial height increase of the marked circumferential middle band, following the vertical green line.

ear_underside_edge_finish.value: Round the marked lower-body lanyard ear underside outer perimeter to match the opposite face.

ear_underside_stitch_detail.value: Add raised imitation stitches along the marked U-shaped ear underside perimeter, matching opposite-face stitch style, dimensions and path.

ear_root_clipped_stitch.value: Use the regular stitch matching the one above at the marked ear root; trim off the lower portion occluded by the circular body.
